items.name: Cloak of the Dance
items.lore: Grey, with the ring of stones in white. Given to those who took back the Dance.

items.name: Trilithon Ring
items.lore: Three stones, two standing and one across.

items.name: Heel-Stone Torc
items.lore: With a chip of the heel stone set in the clasp.

items.name: Amesbury Grave Bracer
items.lore: The Sisters' work, linen over leather.

items.name: Bolster's Arm-Ring
items.lore: Won from Bolster, Herald of Golestandt. A man could wear it as a belt.

items.name: Cormoran's Tooth
items.lore: Won from Cormoran when the Dance held. As long as your hand.

draughts: The Sisters' own. It tastes of lavender.
Chalk-downs thyme, steeped in spring water.
Brewed for midsummer at the stones. Everything comes back faster after a cup.
